label: Anna Paulina Luna
narrative: Luna is the member who converted House UAP interest into a standing institutional instrument. She was waived onto the July 2023 subcommittee and used her rounds to establish two things on the record that the committee has pursued ever since: that Grusch had received DoD Prepublication and Security Review approval for what he was saying, and that he feared for his life. On 11 February 2025 Oversight Chairman James Comer created the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets and put her in the chair; she and Comer sent letters to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and CIA Director John Ratcliffe demanding a briefing on all UAP records in their possession. On 9 September 2025 she chaired the third House UAP hearing and used her opening statement to document the concealment architecture in plain language - that DoD told committee staff that under special access program rules only members of the House Armed Services Committee and the Defense Subcommittee of Appropriations could be read in, and that any other member needed the approval of the chairman and ranking member of both. That is the mechanism: an Oversight committee with subpoena power told it lacks the clearance jurisdiction to see what it is investigating. In the same statement she called former AARO director Sean Kirkpatrick 'a documented liar' and read Christopher Mellon's assessment of AARO's historical report into the record. On 1 April 2026 she wrote Secretary Hegseth demanding AARO's unreleased UAP video files after whistleblowers told the Task Force they exist; the Department blew the deadline in mid-April 2026 and she publicly raised the subpoena. On 9 June 2026 she called on the White House to grant immunity to whistleblowers willing to name locations of recovered craft and technology.
